infos.title: See you at number 17.
infos.accessText: Rue de Beauvais, in central Amiens. A small terrace on sunny days. Easiest: order ahead, drop by, leave with your bag.
infos.mapTitle: Map to Maily, 17 rue de Beauvais in Amiens

items.a: Add your dishes from the menu, pick a pick-up time, then send the order on WhatsApp. Maily confirms by message. You can also call +33 6 25 65 72 12.
Tuesday to Saturday, 10:30 am to 2 pm and 5 pm to 7:30 pm. Closed on Sundays and Mondays. Any special closures are shown at the top of the site.
You pay in the shop when you pick up your order.
Yes, all our chicken recipes are halal. A question about another dish? Just ask, we're happy to help.

items.q: Do I need to pre-order the roast chicken?
items.a: Yes. The roast chicken and the grill discovery box are made to order: place your order the day before at the latest.

items.q: Do you do platters for events?
items.a: Yes: birthdays, thesis defences, seminars, meetings, drinks. Spring rolls, samosas, mini banh mi, skewers and desserts, on quote. Message us on WhatsApp with the date and number of guests.

banhMi.lead: A crusty baguette, meat marinated in-house, carrots, coriander. Saigon's sandwich, made here in Amiens.

sections.title: What's inside
sections.text: The baguette is crusty outside and light inside. We fill it with homemade marinated meat, carrots and fresh coriander. It's the dish our customers mention most in their reviews.

sections.title: Three versions
sections.text: Chicken (halal), beef, or veggie. For lunch, add spring rolls at €1 each or a chè for dessert.

sections.title: Ready when you arrive
sections.text: Order on the site, pick a time, the order goes out on WhatsApp. Drop by 17 rue de Beauvais, it's ready.

boBun.metaDescription: Maily's bo bun in Amiens: rice vermicelli, stir-fried beef, raw veg and crispy onions. Also with halal chicken or vegetarian. Takeaway, rue de Beauvais.
boBun.title: Bo bun, fresh and generous.
boBun.lead: Rice vermicelli, stir-fried beef, crunchy raw veg and crispy onions. A full lunch bowl for €8.50.

sections.title: The bowl, layer by layer
sections.text: Rice vermicelli and raw veg at the bottom. The stir-fried meat and crispy onions on top. Mix it all just before eating.

sections.title: Beef, chicken or veggie
sections.text: Classic bo bun is made with beef. There's also a chicken version (halal) and a vegetarian one, same price.

sections.title: To take away, no waiting
sections.text: Order before you leave, it goes out on WhatsApp. At 17 rue de Beauvais, your bowl is ready.
